channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: Good news: Buying a home might actually be more affordable in 2026
item.description: A housing reset is coming in 2026, Redfin forecasts, with slower home price growth and more listings, giving buyers a better shot at home ownership.

item.title: How Guantanamo Bay actually works, according to a former detainee
item.description: Mohamedou Ould Slahi recounts 15 years at Guantanamo, describing the torture, daily life, and his journey toward justice and reconciliation.

item.title: Elon Musk says Tesla FSD lets you text while being driven. I tried it. Here's what happened.
item.description: A hands-on review confirms the FSD system allows texting, even through tricky traffic.

item.title: Luigi Mangione stripped naked for a three-minute 'in-depth search,' police testimony reveals
item.description: Mangione was arrested wearing two coats and three pairs of pants. Thursday's court hearing came on the first anniversary of Brian Thompson's murder.

item.title: Read the internal memo that Meta's top lawyer behind its FTC victory sent announcing she's leaving for Apple
item.description: Jennifer Newstead led Meta's legal team through major regulatory battles, including an FTC antitrust win.

item.title: Elon Musk says Tesla FSD will let you use your phone in some cases. Police say don't do that.
item.description: Tesla CEO Elon Musk said Full Self-Driving now allows drivers to text and drive in certain traffic conditions. Police advise against it.

item.title: Ulta Beauty says its bet on K-beauty is paying off
item.description: CEO Kecia Steelman said in an earnings call that K-beauty is driving sales and bringing in new customers.

item.title: Russia is blocking Snapchat and Roblox, saying they're used for 'terrorist activities'
item.description: Moscow said on Thursday that it's also moved to "impose restrictive measures" on Meta's FaceTime for similar reasons.

item.title: The Godmother of AI says she is disappointed by AI's messaging: It's either 'doomsday' or 'total utopian'
item.description: Fei-Fei Li said that this "extreme rhetoric" is filling tech discourse and misinforming people outside Silicon Valley.

item.title: LinkedIn is scrapping its associate product manager program and rebuilding around full-stack talent
item.description: LinkedIn is ending its associate product manager program. Now, it will train new hires to code, design, and ship products as "full-stack builders."
